scientific_integrity: The infinite classification is proved by an exact divisibility argument. The accompanying computation is only a regression check and is not used to infer the all-parameter result.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only harmonious pairs of the form \(2^a,2^bq\) with \(q\) an odd prime. It does not classify arbitrary friends of powers of two or cases with higher odd-prime exponent.
title: Powers of two in two-prime-support harmonious pairs
